note: Fetched once from UniProt (CC BY 4.0) and InterPro (CC0). taxon_domain: NCBI taxon id to domain of life (UniProt taxonomy). virus_host_domain: viral test protein to its host's domain (UniProtKB virus_hosts). retired_interpro: InterPro accessions named by any audited generation, absent from release 109.0 and reported deleted (HTTP 410) by the EBI API, to the member signatures they held.
